source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting failed brake tests in a vehicle inspection report

1. Start with the inspection records.
2.
completion:
Find those vehicle inspection reports with brake test failures.
3. Is the 'Brake Test Result' field on the inspection report filled with a percentage number only? e.g. "82"
  * [Yes](#yes)
  * [No](#no)

# YES

Congratulations, you have found a vehicle inspection report that doesn't clearly show the brake test has actually failed!

Go ahead and document this incident by first correcting the Brake Test Result field, and then adding a comment at the end of the document saying:
> The brake test details have been relocated to the vehicle inspection sheet comments section for clarity.


# NO

Take a look through the notes on the inspection report.
Document the following details on each brake failure on an inspection sheet.

1. The date
2. Percentage value of the test failure
3. Any additional details you can find about the test failure.
4. Photos
